title: NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) — Sworn Contents Amount a Payment Is Measured Against
content:
Contents payment rule on the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own), reading every contents proof of loss filed for the date of loss, under any claim number for that date.

**Rule.** The sworn contents amount a contents payment is measured against is settled as follows: when the latest contents proof of loss for the date of loss was received after the proof-of-loss period, counted by adding the days to the date of loss on the calendar, the amounts sworn on the other contents proofs of loss for the date of loss are added together and the late one is left out; when more than one contents proof of loss was filed for the date of loss and the latest was received within that period, the amounts sworn on all of them are added together, each later proof of loss claiming an additional amount; otherwise it is the amount sworn on the latest contents proof of loss for the date of loss.

The proof-of-loss period is 60 calendar days.

## Condition — result

- **Latest received on day 61 or later** → add the amounts on the other contents proofs of loss; leave the late one out.
- **Two or more, latest received by day 60** → add all of them; each later one claims an additional amount.
- **One, received by day 60** → the amount on it.

## Cases (hypothetical; date of loss 2 November)

- 11,000.00 received 20 November and 4,000.00 received 1 January (day 60): 15,000.00.
- The same two, the second received 2 January (day 61): 11,000.00.
